patthana11.16:1.1: dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na ajjhattārammaṇaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na bahiddhārammaṇaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassana sappaṭighaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca-. na sanidassanasappaṭigho na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā-. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanasappaṭigho na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca
patthana11.16:3.1: na anidassanaappaṭigho na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. cha,
patthana11.16:4.1: na anidassanasappaṭighaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. na anidassanasappaṭighaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassanaappaṭigho na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. cha,
patthana11.16:5.1: na anidassanaappaṭighaṃ na kusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na anidassana appaṭigho na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. cha, na sanidassanaappaṭighaṃ na kusalañca na anidasasnaapapaṭighaṃ na kusalañca dhamma paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. cha, anidassanaappaṭighaṃ na kusalañca na anidassanaṃ appaṭighaṃ na kusalañca dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na kusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā. cha,
patthana11.16:7.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na akusalaṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca, na sanidassanasappaṭigho na akusalo dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā
patthana11.16:9.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na abyākataṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca na sanidassanasappaṭigho na abyākato dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā
patthana11.16:10.1: hetuyā nava, sabbattha nava, na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na sukhāya
